parts.name: Truman Burbank
parts.role: At the edge of his world

parts.name: Christof
parts.role: The creator in the control room

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: I want to talk to him.

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: I am the creator of a television show that gives hope and joy and inspiration to millions.

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: It's what made you so good to watch.

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: There's no more truth out there

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: than there is in the world I created for you.

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: I know you better than you know yourself.

lines.speaker: truman
lines.text: You never had a camera in my head.

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: I have been watching you your whole life.

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: I was watching when you were born.

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: I was watching when you took your first step.

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: I watched you on your first day of school.

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: The episode when you lost your first tooth.

lines.speaker: christof
lines.text: You're live to the whole world!

lines.speaker: truman
lines.text: In case I don't see ya,

lines.speaker: truman
lines.text: good afternoon, good evening, and good night.

lines.speaker: guard-two
lines.text: Yeah, let's see what else is on.
